newsitem.title: USA: Apple Ventures gets capital asset infusion.
newsitem.headline: Apple Ventures gets capital asset infusion.

text.p: Apple Ventures Inc said Thursday it had entered into an agreement with a brokering trust that will yield it a capital asset infusion of 10.2 million shares of Accord Futronics Corp.

The company said Accord Futronics, a mineral processing firm with net assets totalling more than $42 million and 20.1 million common shares outstanding, had filed to be traded on the OTC Bulletin Board before the close of the first quarter.
It said the shares would provide a ready source of financing for its capital expansion needs.
